purpose: Decode captured Windows-x64 basic Job buffers and check narrow source-view/phase consistency. No live API, original-file/source qualification, report acceptance or complete resource qualification.

actual_capture_shape.flags: ok exactbool; error/returned_bytes strict unsigned32 integers, never bool. Source sets error0 on success. Failure error0 remains failure, not success.
actual_capture_shape.hex: Canonical lowercase even hex, no separators/whitespace. Allocated ACCOUNTING frame is exactly48bytes; allocated PID frame exactly136bytes, independently of APIreturned length.
actual_capture_shape.window: Strict nonnegative integer start/finish with finish>=start. Invalid/malformed window yields query_window_validFalse,raw_completeFalse+issues without erasing independently decoded query data; wrong outerkeys insteadraiseValueError. Equal timestamps remain legal/non-atomic.

accounting.defined: Only okTrue,error0,returned_bytes48,exact frame/schema. Preserve signed time-field values as signed; decoder does not validate CPU-time/period semantics.

pid_list.defined_complete: Only okTrue,error0 and exact frame/schema, raw header assigned==listed==n with0<=n<=16 and8+8*n<=returned_bytes<=136. PIDvalues are unsigned64, firstn entries only.
pid_list.returned_length_is_variable: Empty response can return8bytes and a singlePID can return16; do not require returned_bytes136. Full allocated tail is retained raw evidence but is not an extraPID list or required-zero padding.

minimal_API.input: snapshot isNone for absent/unobserved capture or exact source-shaped dict. A missing query uses accounting=None orpid_list=None while retaining outerkeys. Wrong outerkeys/type raises ValueError(snapshot_schema). No paths/livehandles/callbacks/receipt flags.
minimal_API.decoder_result: Exact frozen/slots DecodedJobSnapshot ordinary immutable result with fresh to_dict(): capture_present,query_window_valid,accounting,pid_list,raw_complete,source_views_consistent,issues,atomic_snapshot,resource_qualified. Component values are exact immutable DecodedQuery orNone. atomic_snapshot/resource_qualified are constantFalse, not readiness input fields.
minimal_API.component_result: Each nonmissing component has status decoded/undefined/malformed, raw_hex/error/returned_bytes retained when representable, fields orNone, source_view_matches bool orNone, issues. Decoded accounting fields use the8names above; decoded PID fields are assigned_count,listed_count,pids. Only complete defined successful frames yield fields.
minimal_API.failed_or_unknown: okFalse yields undefined fields even if the allocated bytes are zero or look plausible. Success with malformed flags/frame/returned length or incomplete PID counts yields malformed fieldsNone. Missing capture/components never become empty Job state. Independently valid other-query data may remain retained; raw_completeFalse blocks phase matching.
minimal_API.source_view_consistency: For defined buffers compare source-reported accounting.decoded(all8strictinteger fields), assigned_count/listed_count and pids(strictinteger list) against freshly decoded bytes. Ignore undefined source summaries. Mismatches are explicitFalse with field paths, not repairs. source_views_consistent isNone unless both query results are defined/complete; malformed source views cannot pass via bool/int coercion.
minimal_API.raw_complete: Both queries have defined complete byte decodes and a valid captured window. Does not mean source views, limits, process identity, output or cleanup are qualified.
minimal_API.phase_output: Immutable fresh to_dict(): status,expected_phase,observed_state,issues,non_atomic_race_possible,resource_qualified. resource_qualifiedFalse/non_atomic_race_possibleTrue always. Status matched_selected_source_phase/counter_or_PID_mismatch/unresolved. No runtime or overall-profile success field.
minimal_API.phase_type_boundary: Require type(decoded) is DecodedJobSnapshot, not a dict, subclass, serialized ready/verified flag or bool. Wrong type raises TypeError(decoder_result_type). This is ordinary API typing, not hostilePython isolation or source/provenance authority.
minimal_API.bounded_invalid_metadata: Returned component output retains ok onlyifexactbool,error/returned_bytes onlyifstrictuint32,raw_hex onlyifexact canonical full48/136-byte frame. Otherwise retainNone plus finite bounded issue names; never return huge/invalid rawhex or copied arbitrarysource-view containers. Input itself remains caller-owned original evidence.

selected_source_phase_policy.own_pid: Strict unsigned32 PID. Positive for all nonempty phases; empty accepts0 orNone because creation may not exist. This is a source-reported numeric identity input, not proof of an owned OS handle.
selected_source_phase_policy.prerequisites: raw_completeTrue AND source_views_consistentTrue. Otherwise unresolved; failed/unknown/malformed or mismatched views cannot match.
selected_source_phase_policy.PID_header: Already checked assigned_count==listed_count==len(pids) in complete decoder; empty is0/0 and onePID is1/1.
selected_source_phase_policy.non_atomic_mismatch: Valid accounting Active1 with a separately observed empty PID list is counter_or_PID_mismatch, with race/unknown cause retained; never normalize it to assigned or finished, and never infer OS limit failure from this pair alone.
selected_source_phase_policy.termination_counter_limit: Terminated0 is the selected retained source-policy expectation, not a universal statement about all Windows termination mechanisms. Nonzero is retained mismatch, not silently rewritten.

separate_report_bindings_design_only.raw_to_journal: A future checker must bind exact raw snapshot to RunJournal event abi_job_snapshot_observed details{stage,ordinal,snapshot}, exact sequence/hash chain and owned captured input bytes. RunJournal fields are sequence,event,details,previous_sha256,sha256. Decoder does not validate that chain.
separate_report_bindings_design_only.phase_identity: Bind configured_empty/before_resume/running_first/running_periodic/after_wait to reported creation/PID/resumption/ownedwait chronology, reservations and observed API returns. A phase string or PID in JSON alone is not ownership.
separate_report_bindings_design_only.terminal_snapshot: Bind report.final_job_snapshot to terminal_observation.observations.job_snapshot.raw/value and its raw publication/return/predicate/scope/ordinal, plus the exact journal raw observation. A late response may be retained with statusfailed and cannot become complete.

limit_metadata.label: Source-reported verify_limits metadata only, NOT raw48/136-derived or OS-enforcement proof.

pending_full_resource_checks: Exact limit/peak readback evidence and finite numeric bounds
Capture file hashes/byte accounting/caps/truncation and both physicalEOF records
Cleanup/lease outcomes and authoritative failure markers/postcleanup seals
Original owner clock300/work295 and child/source bounds
separate_report_bindings_design_only.overall_failure_preserved: A legal finished tuple, EOF and reaped child with exit2 can coexist with an overall failed experiment; this primitive must not convert that into success. PhysicalEOF alone never establishes child exit.

fixture_plan_before_any_code: Freeze a small set of actual-shaped synthetic records: legal empty(return8),assigned(return16),finished(return8); running_or_finished bothlegal branches; non-atomic mismatch; failedzero buffers; wrongreturned lengths/truncation/counts; raw-vs-summary mismatch/boolcoercion; nonzero unused tail; missingcapture; exactPID/count corruption. Expected structs are authored literals/framing only, no live samples replayed as qualification.
root_clarifications: Immutable typeddecoder result onlyatphaseboundary, not serialized readiness.
No report/fullresource/platform checker implementation in this version.
